UserState.title: UserState
UserState.description: Stores the entire application state for a single user as a serialized JSON string to allow offline-first sync.

stateStr.description: A JSON serialized representation of the user's entire app state (transactions, loans, budgets).

updatedAt.description: When the state was last synced.

/userStates/{userId}.description: User state documents, keyed by the user's ID.
